entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How is Futaba?
I'm worried about her.
I haven't heard anything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, this ain't just some[n]normal oversleeping stuff![n]Our deadline's tomorrow!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If Futaba's not up by then...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: But can she really do anything[n]even if she does wake up...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Honestly, I'm not sure.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Either way, our only option[n]is to put our trust in her.
That's right.
We're so powerless...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: If she's been asleep all this[n]time, do you think she's having[n]some kind of long dream?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, dreams are said to be the[n]sorting of memories, after all.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: She surely needs ample time[n]to face her troubled past.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Her past? You think she's really[n]facing all that shit right now...?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If that is the case... she[n]would probably need a great[n]amount more time to do so.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But considering how she had us[n]wrapped around her finger...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I feel as though she'll be[n]able to pull this off.
I'm sure we'll be fine.
I believe in Futaba.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Indeed.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, just give us a ring[n]if anything changes!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're counting on you!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I have to agree with Makoto.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who knows how this might turn out...
